message.text: I should also check internal/base and other internal packages for declared methods like markdown Service functions and base resource name helpers, plus profile methods. I'll compile a list of candidate function/method names and count their call sites across non-test Go files, excluding the declaring file, to see which ones look unused. Writing a quick script to do this counting.

args.command:
cd /bench/repo && cat > /tmp/fanin.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# collect declarations under internal/ (funcs and methods), non-test
grep -rn "^func " --include='*.go' internal/ | grep -v "_test.go" > /tmp/decls.txt
: > /tmp/fanin.txt
while IFS= read -r line; do
  file="${line%%:*}"
  rest="${line#*:}"
  lineno="${rest%%:*}"
  sig="${line#*:*:func }"
  # strip receiver
  case "$sig" in
    "("*) sig="${sig#*) }";;
  esac
  name="${sig%%(*)}"
  name="${name%%(*}"
  name="${name%%[*}"
  # skip non-identifiers
  case "$name" in
    ""|*" "*) continue;;
  esac
  # count callers: occurrences of name( in non-test go files, excluding decl line file? count all files
  cnt=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -w "$name" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "^\./proto/gen" | grep "$name(" | grep -v "^$file:$lineno:" | wc -l)
  echo "$cnt|$name|$file:$lineno" >> /tmp/fanin.txt
done < /tmp/decls.txt
sort -t'|' -k1 -rn /tmp/fanin.txt | head -30
EOF
bash /tmp/fanin.sh

message.text: I'm setting up qualified counting for exported package-level funcs in internal/, mapping each to its package name and counting non-test usages repo-wide excluding the declaring file, then doing similar approximate counting for methods like markdown.Service's ExtractAll and GenerateSnippet, flagging ambiguous cases.

args.command:
cd /bench/repo && cat > /tmp/fanin2.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
: > /tmp/f2.txt
# package-level exported funcs
grep -rn "^func [A-Z]" --include='*.go' internal/ | grep -v "_test.go" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  file="${line%%:*}"
  rest="${line#*:}"; lineno="${rest%%:*}"
  name=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/.*func \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\).*/\1/')
  pkg=$(grep -m1 "^package " "$file" | awk '{print $2}')
  cnt=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -F "$pkg.$name(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "^\./proto/gen" | wc -l)
  echo "$cnt|func $pkg.$name|$file:$lineno" >> /tmp/f2.txt
done
# methods (exported)
grep -rn "^func ([a-zA-Z_]* \*\?[A-Za-z0-9_]*) [A-Z]" --include='*.go' internal/ | grep -v "_test.go" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  file="${line%%:*}"
  rest="${line#*:}"; lineno="${rest%%:*}"
  name=$(echo "$line" | sed 's/.*) \([A-Za-z0-9_]*\)(.*/\1/')
  cnt=$(grep -rn --include='*.go' -F ".$name(" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "^\./proto/gen" | grep -v "^$file:" | wc -l)
  echo "$cnt|method .$name|$file:$lineno" >> /tmp/f2.txt
done
sort -t'|' -k1 -rn /tmp/f2.txt | head -25
EOF
bash /tmp/fanin2.sh

h10.

**`(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approximately 28 call sites (29 textual occurrences, one of which is the declaration).**

This is the placeholder-binding helper in the CEL-filter-to-SQL renderer: it appends a value to `r.args`, bumps the placeholder counter, and returns the dialect-appropriate placeholder token (`$N` for Postgres, `?` otherwise). Essentially every branch of the renderer that emits a bound value has to route through it, which is why the fan-in is so concentrated.

All callers live in the same file, `internal/filter/render.go`, spread across the comparison, `LIKE`/`ILIKE`, regex, `IN`-list, and JSON-array rendering paths — for example lines 213, 287, 329, 335, 403, the tag-matching cluster at 454-467 and 503-509, the list handling at 530-536, regex at 567-570, the case-insensitive helper at 583-588, and the JSON payload paths at 698-775. Line 863 is a thin wrapper that just forwards to it.

Runners-up, for calibration:

- `(*Schema).Field` — `internal/filter/schema.go:67` — about 19 callers, split between `internal/filter/render.go` (9) and `internal/filter/parser.go` (10).
- `jsonArrayExpr` — `internal/filter/render.go:944` — roughly 16.
- `(*markdownRenderer).renderChildren` — `internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:170` — roughly 14.

A caveat on method: I counted call sites textually (name-qualified, excluding `_test.go` files, generated code under `proto/gen`, and declaration lines), not with a type-aware call-graph tool, so these are approximations. I discarded two false leaders that a raw name count surfaces: `New` (236 hits, matching every `New(` in the repo rather than the `scheduler`/`gemini`/`openai` constructors) and `Next` (55 hits, essentially all `sql.Rows.Next`, not `internal/scheduler`'s parser method). `addArg` is unaffected by that ambiguity since the name is unique in this codebase.
